name: Knitewings™
description:
About This Game

Knitewings™ is a fast-paced anime action rail shooter where four angelic sisters battle across a fractured universe connecting Heaven, Earth, Purgatory and Hell. Create powerful builds, master devastating weapons and abilities, and take on colossal bosses in a high-speed adventure inspired by arcade classics.


Build Your Combat Style

Combine devastating firepower, automated support systems and unique character abilities to create distinct combat styles and powerful synergies.


As the boundaries between worlds begin to fracture, four angelic sisters are drawn into a conflict that threatens the fate of the entire universe.


Melee Combat & Combos

Master close-range combat with melee attacks, combo chains, precise parries and devastating finishers.


Choose your angel — Michela, Gabriela, Raffaela or Uriela — each featuring unique stats, abilities, elemental powers and combat synergies.


Colossal Boss Battles

Face gigantic multi-phase bosses featuring devastating attacks, unique mechanics and cinematic encounters.


Equip powerful weapons, support abilities and Specials, then customize your combat style through upgrades and synergies. Combine devastating firepower, automated support systems and unique character abilities to forge powerful builds tailored to the way you play.


Elemental Specials

Unleash devastating abilities tied to each sister's unique elemental power.

Core Features

  • Four Playable Sisters: Choose between Michela, Gabriela, Raffaela and Uriela, each featuring unique stats, abilities, elemental powers and combat synergies.
  • Build Your Combat Style: Combine devastating firepower, automated support systems and unique character abilities to create unique combat styles and powerful synergies.
  • Fast-Paced Rail Shooter Action: Experience classic arcade-inspired rail shooter gameplay featuring responsive controls, challenging enemy formations and intense high-speed action.
  • Automated Support Systems: Enhance your arsenal with offensive and defensive support abilities, including lightning strikes, orbiting blades, protective energy spheres, explosive comets and more.
  • Melee Combat & Special Abilities: Strike enemies at close range with powerful melee attacks and unleash devastating elemental Specials tied to each sister's unique element.
  • Colossal Boss Battles: Face gigantic multi-phase bosses featuring unique mechanics, devastating attacks and cinematic encounters.
  • A Fractured Universe: Battle across Heaven, Earth, Purgatory, Hell and the mysterious realms that connect them as the boundaries between worlds begin to collapse.
  • Progression & Unlockables: Progressively unlock sisters, weapons, support abilities and upgrades, expanding your arsenal and discovering new build possibilities.

Heaven, Earth, Purgatory and Hell are beginning to collide. Take flight and forge your destiny among the ruins of a fractured universe.
